newsitem.title: CANADA: Ontario revises 97/98 deficit down to C$6.575 bln.
newsitem.headline: Ontario revises 97/98 deficit down to C$6.575 bln.

text.p: Ontario Finance Minister Ernie Eves on Friday revised the government's 1997-98 projected deficit down C$5 million to C$6.575 billion.
In his first-quarter outlook, Eves said the government's plan to eliminate the budget deficit by 2000-01 was on track.
Revenues for the fiscal year ending March 31 were forecast at C$48.4 billion, unchanged from the budget plan released in May.
Expenses for the year were estimated at C$54.3 billion, down C$5 million from the budget plan.
